title: Forest spiders
description:
This is a first person action adventure game,The player is located in a forest full of spiders,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players have both long knives and bows and arrows, and must avoid or kill monsters,Players need to survive as long as possible.

Control keys:

Right-click targeting

WASD movement

The left Shift running

Left mouse button attack

Space leaping

The left Ctrl squats

Mouse control direction

Mouse wheel switch weapons
